title: Logo color options

location.series: IBM Logo Guidelines for Strategic Partners / Version 1.2 / copyright 2023

slide_intent: Use color and background together so a familiar mark remains legible without losing its approved identity.
strategic_value: A limited set of IBM logo treatments can maintain recognition across partner materials.
demonstration: Four quadrants show positive Black and Blue60 on light grounds, reversed White and Blue50 on black, beside the usage conditions.
practical_value: Choose one approved color/version/background combination for the actual setting.

content_islands.name: Color rules
content_islands.spec: Place the conditional rules in the left column.

content_islands.name: Positive treatments
content_islands.spec: Compare Black and Blue60 versions across the upper row.

content_islands.name: Reversed treatments
content_islands.spec: Compare White and Blue50 on black across the lower row.

reference_purposes.Expression: The four specimens establish black, white and blue as the permitted logo appearances.
reference_purposes.Application: The page pairs each logo treatment with its background condition.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Positive Black or Blue60 uses light-to-medium gray; reversed White uses medium gray to black; reversed Blue50 is for black backgrounds only. Imagery must provide a clear, simple and contrasting placement.

ingredient.name: 8-bar logo color
ingredient.role: Keep the approved mark clear on the chosen background.
ingredient.application: Select positive Black or Blue60 for light-to-medium gray, reversed White for medium gray to black, or reversed Blue50 on black only.
ingredient.scope: Version1.2 strategic-partner logo treatments, not the full IBM palette or a permission to recolor logo artwork freely.
